chunk_map.heading: On Monday the team decides, not the three of you

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Harm: a projected slide the room cannot resolve. Closest: L4 'What the three of you built' and L6 'The first wall you expect to hit' - 'the three of you' is the trio the APT101 arc names (sibling slides use it, e.g. sharing-is-harder-than-building L8) and 'the first wall' is introduced by its own colon list in the same sentence.
Harm: callback by deck position. Closest: L4 'What the three of you built' names the work, not a file or an earlier slide by position. No 'opening lecture' / 'earlier slide' pointers.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Harm: dead beat reference. Closest: L4 'What the three of you built' - the trio's build is the module arc itself (host lecture apt101-from-us-to-the-team includes this slide); no 'the X you did/saw/caught' naming a specific beat.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no guess/predict or demo beat on the slide

rules_evaluated.evidence: Harm: slide says nothing standalone. Closest: L8 closer sentence, but L4-L6 carry the claim (proposal not decision, what the proposal carries, named owners).

Harm: header contradicted by body. L1 'On Monday the team decides, not the three of you' vs L4 'a proposal, not a decision. The team ... decides' and L8 'Bring it to the team on Monday' - header is literally true of the body.

Harm: visible LLM tics. Closest: L4 'a proposal, not a decision' is a single contrast, not 'Not X. Not Y. Z.'; L6 'who reads what comes back, who corrects it' is a pair, not a triple; no superlatives, no number+retraction, no empty-leg verb triplets, no abstraction-noun stacks.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Harm: maintainer dialect on a wall. Closest: L6 'wall' and 'part' - ordinary engineering words ('first wall you expect to hit'); no surface-as-noun, beat, mood, compendium, forcing function in body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: grep -c '\*\*' on body lines 1-9 -> 0 (bold only in maintainer/backing tail); budget <=1 met.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Presence precedes content — verify against the composed deck, not long-read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Harm: section absent from composed deck. Slide file included by curriculum/lectures/apt101-from-us-to-the-team.md (grep -rln 'the-team-decides-on-monday' curriculum --include='*.md' lists it); lecture content reaches the deck under .phase--lecture.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Numbering — position is computed, content ordinals are linted.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no Phase/Step headers or ordinals; check-slide-numbering.js --file exit 0

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Page geometry dies at the cut; reading order survives.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-deixis.js --file curriculum/slides/the-team-decides-on-monday.md -> 'OK - 1 files, no page-geometry pointers across the slide cut.' exit 0.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: In-deck links work now; whether they EARN their place is open.
Slide size — 210 words / 6 bullets, and the cap is machine-checked.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-size.js --file curriculum/slides/the-team-decides-on-monday.md -> 'oversized: 0', exit 0 (one slide, ~110 words, 0 bullets).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Heading grammar is the mood switch, and it is load-bearing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Lecture-register slide; L1 header is a declarative claim ('On Monday the team decides, not the three of you'), as the grammar requires for a consolidation beat.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A bullet earns its slot or dies — three classes that read as rigour and carry nothing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Closest: L8 'Their changes are how it becomes theirs.' - a closing line, but it supplies the reason for the instruction before it ('expect them to change it'), not a restatement of the header; L6 'A part with no name is a part not built yet.' states the consequence of the named-person ask, not a repeat. Optional trim offered in suggestions.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A retitled slide re-earns its bullets against the new header.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: new slide composed 2026-10-07 per maintainer STATUS; no retitle with inherited body
